hero.title: MEGA RESORT KARIMUNJAWA
hero.description: More than just a place to stay, Mega Resort Karimunjawa is a destination where nature, comfort, and serenity meet. Surrounded by the beauty of Karimunjawa’s islands, every moment is designed to let you slow down, breathe deeper, and enjoy an authentic tropical escape from sunrise to sunset.

about.title: Discover the Beauty of Mega Resort Karimun Jawa
about.description: Nestled within the breathtaking waters of the Karimunjawa archipelago, Mega Resort Karimunjawa offers a secluded island escape where tropical nature meets modern comfort. Located on a private island surrounded by the pristine marine environment of Karimunjawa National Park.

videoBanner.title: Mega Resort Karimunjawa
videoBanner.description: Karimunjawa is a tropical sanctuary of natural beauty that gently awakens the senses. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and endless horizons, the island offers a peaceful escape where soft ocean breezes and golden sunsets shape unforgettable moments. As daylight fades, the sky transforms into warm hues, creating a serene atmosphere that invites you to slow down, reconnect, and embrace the rhythm of island life at Mega Resort Karimunjawa.

gallery.title: Gallary of Unforgettable Says
gallery.description: Every corner of Mega Resort Karimunjawa brings unforgettable beauty—from serene ocean panoramas and elegant architecture to warm moments shaped in every experience. Explore the beauty we bring to life, one frame at a time.
gallery.bottomCaption: From tranquil sunrises to breathtaking sunsets, every frame tells the story of an extraordinary journey awaiting you at Mega Resort Karimunjawa.

villa.title: A Luxurious Stay Over The Ocean

dining.title: A Taste of Coastal Elegance
dining.description: Indulge in an exquisite culinary journey where local Indonesian flavors blend seamlessly with contemporary international cuisine. Savor freshly caught seafood, farm-to-table tropical produce, and bespoke candlelit dinners under the starlit sky.
dining.subDescription: Celebrate love and life with our signature beachfront private dining set against the enchanting backdrop of the Karimunjawa coastline.

packages.title: Popular Package for Destination On KarimunJawa
packages.description: Discover curated stays and experiences in Karimunjawa — from relaxing beachfront accommodations to exciting island activities, all designed for a seamless tropical getaway.

news.title: Discover Our All Latest News
news.description: Explore a collection of premium amenities crafted to make every moment of your stay more relaxing, convenient, and memorable.

footer.brandDescription: Mega Resort Karimunjawa is a premier luxury eco-resort nestled in the pristine Karimunjawa National Park, providing an unforgettable escape between azure waters and golden sunsets.
